contribution.position: On reliability grounds the change is not ready: the 30-day error rate of 2.4% is nearly five times the 0.5% SLO and two sev2 incidents were logged in that window, so the service is already outside its reliability budget before this change lands. Green tests (412 passed, 87% coverage) and in-budget p99 do not offset a live SLO breach; the reliability gap should be closed or explained before proceeding.
